_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Tribal Aggression#000.src: My tribe worries our own business, stranger.
Tribal Aggression#000.dst: 我が部族のことは我らの問題だ、よそ者よ。

Tribal Aggression#001.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find it, I await your return!
Tribal Aggression#001.dst: 奴らはトーテムを隠しているはずだが、見つけられたなら、帰りを待っているぞ！

Tribal Aggression#002.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt to steal back the totems, and live in peace.
Tribal Aggression#002.dst: 願わくば、我ら二つの野営地がもう互いの土地に踏み入りトーテムを奪い合うことなく、平和に暮らせるように。

Tribal Aggression#003.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.
Tribal Aggression#003.dst: そ、それはトーテムか？ああ、梟が我が元を離れて久しい。しかし、鷲と梟のトーテムは同じ神秘の力を持つのだろうか。

Tribal Aggression#004.src: Have you gotten our totem back yet? The Eagle camp is across the river, on the other side of the canyon.
Tribal Aggression#004.dst: トーテムはもう取り返したか？鷲族の野営地は川の向こう、峡谷の反対側だ。

Tribal Aggression#006.src: My tribes worries our own business, stranger.
Tribal Aggression#006.dst: 我が部族のことは我らの問題だ、よそ者よ。
Tribal Aggression#006.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#007.src: Oh, my apologies, I did not realize you are a warrior of the province! We would be grateful of your help.
Tribal Aggression#007.dst: おお、すまぬ、この地方の戦士とは気づかなかった！力を貸してもらえるならありがたい。
Tribal Aggression#007.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#008.src: Our sacred owl totem that we worship was stolen by the cunning Eagle Tribe many years ago. Its magical properties used to bring prosperity to our camp.
Tribal Aggression#008.dst: 我らが崇める聖なる梟のトーテムは、何年も前にずる賢い鷲族に盗まれた。その魔力はかつて我らの野営地に繁栄をもたらしていた。
Tribal Aggression#008.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#009.src: However, the Eagle tribe are not victorious, we possess their mystic eagle totem, but alas, I do not know who was the original thief.
Tribal Aggression#009.dst: だが鷲族も勝ったわけではない。我らは彼らの神秘の鷲のトーテムを持っている。しかし、最初の盗人が誰だったのかは分からぬ。
Tribal Aggression#009.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#010.src: We have been at war for years now, despite being neighbors. Without our totem, our rivalry will continue for ages and peace will never again be felt in our hearts.
Tribal Aggression#010.dst: 隣人同士でありながら、我らは長年争ってきた。トーテムがなければ、この対立は果てなく続き、心に平和が戻ることはない。
Tribal Aggression#010.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#011.src: Retrieve our totem, and the blessing of the Owl spirit will be with you.
Tribal Aggression#011.dst: トーテムを取り戻せば、梟の精霊の加護が汝と共にあろう。
Tribal Aggression#011.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#012.src: Now, enter the Eagle Camp across the river, you may have to search the camp, I'm sure they have hidden our totem!
Tribal Aggression#012.dst: さあ、川向こうの鷲族の野営地へ行け。野営地を探し回ることになるだろう、奴らは必ずトーテムを隠している！
Tribal Aggression#012.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#013.src: Enter the Eagle Camp and talk to Favian
Tribal Aggression#013.dst: 鷲族の野営地に入り、Favian と話す

Tribal Aggression#014.src: Greetings, what brings you to the noble Eagle tribe?
Tribal Aggression#014.dst: ようこそ、高貴なる鷲族に何の用だ？
Tribal Aggression#014.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#015.src: You seek the Owl totem? The cursed Owl tribe trying to retain their lost dignity again.
Tribal Aggression#015.dst: 梟のトーテムを探しているだと？呪われた梟族め、また失った誇りを取り戻そうというのか。
Tribal Aggression#015.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#016.src: Why should we give you their totem back? They stole our source of enlightenment all those years ago.
Tribal Aggression#016.dst: なぜ奴らにトーテムを返さねばならん？何年も前、我らの叡智の源を盗んだのは奴らだ。
Tribal Aggression#016.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#017.src: Tell you what, if you can retrieve our Eagle Totem, I will allow you to go return the Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#017.dst: こうしよう。我らの鷲のトーテムを取り戻せたら、梟のトーテムを返しに行くことを許そう。
Tribal Aggression#017.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#018.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find, I await your return!
Tribal Aggression#018.dst: 奴らはトーテムを隠しているはずだが、見つけられたなら、帰りを待っているぞ！
Tribal Aggression#018.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#019.src: Bring back the Eagle Totem from the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#019.dst: 梟族の野営地から鷲のトーテムを取り戻す

Tribal Aggression#020.src: Wonderful! You may now enter the cave to retrieve the blasted Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#020.dst: 素晴らしい！では洞窟に入り、忌々しい梟のトーテムを取ってくるがいい。
Tribal Aggression#020.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#021.src: Be careful, there are Eagle guardians in the cave, be prepared traveller.
Tribal Aggression#021.dst: 気をつけよ、洞窟には鷲族の守護者がいる。覚悟しておけ、旅人よ。
Tribal Aggression#021.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#022.src: Once you get the totem, you may return it to its original tribe.
Tribal Aggression#022.dst: トーテムを手に入れたら、元の部族に返してやるがいい。
Tribal Aggression#022.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#023.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt steal back the totems, and live in peace.
Tribal Aggression#023.dst: 願わくば、我ら二つの野営地がもう互いの土地に踏み入りトーテムを奪い合うことなく、平和に暮らせるように。
Tribal Aggression#023.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#024.src: Anyways, hurry up, even the thought of the two totems sharing the same space makes me sick.
Tribal Aggression#024.dst: とにかく急げ。二つのトーテムが同じ場所にあると考えるだけで気分が悪い。
Tribal Aggression#024.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#025.src: Retrieve the Owl Totem and return it to the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#025.dst: 梟のトーテムを取り戻し、梟族の野営地に返す

Tribal Aggression#026.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and the Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.
Tribal Aggression#026.dst: そ、それはトーテムか？ああ、梟が我が元を離れて久しい。しかし、鷲と梟のトーテムは同じ神秘の力を持つのだろうか。
Tribal Aggression#026.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#027.src: To think, such a long war could end so quickly and by the help of a single person.
Tribal Aggression#027.dst: これほど長い戦いが、たった一人の助けでこうも早く終わるとは。
Tribal Aggression#027.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#028.src: Many thanks to you! I shall keep my promise, please accept this reward, and may the Owl be forever with you.
Tribal Aggression#028.dst: 心から感謝する！約束は守ろう、この褒美を受け取ってくれ。梟が永遠に汝と共にあらんことを。
Tribal Aggression#028.speaker: Caras
